pages.title: Stress
pages.text:
[#](FFFFFF)[#]() **Key points**

- [#](FFFFFF)[#]() Machines use **stress capacity**, counted in su. Sources provide it.
- Ask for more than the sources give and the **whole network stops**.
- Faster spinning costs more, and also gives more.
- Goggles show the numbers.

Spinning is not free. Every machine uses some of the **stress capacity** of its [#](7A3C9A)[network](entry://glossary/kinetic_network)[#](), measured in [#](7A3C9A)[su](entry://glossary/su)[#]() (stress units). Sources provide capacity, machines consume it.

[#](FFFFFF)[#]() **Watch out:** if the machines on a network ask for more than the sources give, it is [#](7A3C9A)[overstressed](entry://glossary/overstressed)[#](): the **whole network stops**, not just one machine.\
\
The fix is more sources, fewer machines, or slower speed.

pages.title: Stressometer
pages.text: A gauge that shows how much of a network's capacity is in use. With [#](2E5AAC)[goggles](entry://create_basics/tools_wrench)[#]() on, it names the exact numbers.

**Faster costs more.** A machine's stress cost goes up with its [#](7A3C9A)[RPM](entry://glossary/rpm)[#](), and a source's capacity goes up with RPM as well. A fast network can carry more, but each machine on it also eats more.

**Reading it.** Wear [#](2E5AAC)[Goggles](entry://create_basics/tools_wrench)[#]() and look at a machine for its Stress Impact, or a source for its Stress Capacity. Item tooltips (hold Shift) say Low, Moderate or High stress impact.

pages.title: Engineer's Goggles
pages.text: Shows Kinetic Stats on any machine: impact, capacity and speed. Steam [#](7A3C9A)[boilers](entry://glossary/boiler)[#]() show their power level too.

Large sources such as [#](2E5AAC)[large water wheels and steam engines](entry://create_basics/power_sources)[#]() exist because a lot of machines need a lot of capacity. Exact numbers vary by [#](7A3C9A)[config](entry://glossary/config)[#](), so check the goggles in your own world.
